item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father as supreme leader
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named his successor, Iranian state TV announced early Monday, as the war that began with his father's killing less than two weeks ago took a dramatic turn.
